description: PLANNED (ADR-054, plan T21): Create, edit, submit and retire definitions in the caller's namespace (POST /api/v1/definitions, PATCH /api/v1/definitions/:id with inventory.definition-request@1 → inventory.definition@1). A creator's definition goes to review; a service's or app's is published when it asks. It becomes active when OpenVibe.Inventory implements the route.
